messages:
morgan: Quick FYI — planning a small canary for the privilege refresh next Tue. sampling ~2% of admin-flagged principals across infra + analytics. need signoff before we run.

sarah: what's the exact sampling rule? can we exclude service accounts and infra pipelines?

chris: +1 exclude svcaccts with active KMS grants. also want audit-log retention check (90d) before we touch entitlements.

morgan: plan sketch: dry-run (audit-only) Mon 09:00 PT, canary Tue 10:00 PT, gated full rollout Thu. dry-run will only produce remediation plan, no changes. canary will apply to the sampled set only.

jamie: how are we detecting "ownerless" or stale owners? last run used `ownership_map --stale 90` which missed some cross-account bindings.

chris: propose adding a KMS-binding pass: query key policies and grants. e.g. `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` + `aws kms list-grants` for accounts. join results to entitlement list.

sarah: I'll own the KMS query integration. we should flag principals that are non-human (svc/infra) so we don't revoke them accidentally. cc @oncall-bot for audit-ingest watch. :eyes: 

oncall-bot: ALERT: audit-log-ingest lag detected for project redwood-prod — current lag 4m.

morgan: ack. hold the canary until ingest lag is <1m. we don't want false negatives on owner evidence.

jamie: also suggesting we send an "entitlement heads-up" DM to owners before any automated revocations. tiny script idea: 

```
owners=$(ownership_map --stale 90)
for o in $owners; do
  slack dm $o "Heads up: we're running an entitlement dry-run on Mon. you'll see a notification if action is proposed. pls ack"
done
```

chris: nice — also add a CSV export with `principal,bindings,kms_keys,evidence_links` so ops can quickly review. I'll prepare the export.

sarah: one more: update runbook with rollback steps — how to re-add admin bit, reapply KMS grants, and who to escalate to if owner doesn't ack within 24h.

chris: I'll update the runbook and add a smoke test: `rbac-check --verify admin` that runs post-change and fails loudly if an expected admin is missing.

morgan: good. calendar invite created for dry-run Mon 09:00 PT. runbook page: https://confluence.redwood/security/priv-refresh (please update).

sarah: calendar accepted. i'll monitor KMS grant queries and the audit-ingest metric. will ping if the bot fires again. :pray:

chris: prepping the canary list now, will drop CSV on the shared drive and DM reviewers.

morgan: thanks all — goal is no surprise outages and clear evidence for each change. post-canary retro Wed 4pm PT. tagging @jamie and @sarah for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
